question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Providing for consideration of the bills (H.R. 139) Sunshine Protection Act; (H.R. 8595) National Security, Department of State, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027; (H.R. 9237) Take Care of America’s Veterans Act; and (H.R. 1181) Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act (H RES 1423)
bill_title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 139) to make daylight savings time permanent, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 8595) making appropriations for national security, Department of State, and related programs for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 9237) to amend titles 10 and 38, United States Code, and other Federal laws, to improve benefits for veterans and the administration of the Department of Veterans Affairs; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1181) to prohibit payment card networks and covered entities from requiring the use of or assigning merchant category codes that distinguish a firearms retailer from general-merchandise retailer or sporting-goods retailer, and for other purposes; and for other purposes.
plain_language: Adopting this rule sets the terms for House debate on H.R. 139 (Sunshine Protection Act of 2025), H.R. 8595, H.R. 9237 (Take Care of America’s Veterans Act), and H.R. 1181 (Protecting Privacy in Purchases Act). A Yea adopts the rule; a Nay rejects it. Rule votes usually split along party lines.
